import numpy as np, json
def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    # find source block: rows/cols containing non-bg
    rows=[i for i in range(H) if any(g[i][j]!=bg for j in range(W))]
    cols=[j for j in range(W) if any(g[i][j]!=bg for i in rows)]
    rs=min(rows); rs0=max(rows)+1
    cs=min(cols); ce=max(cols)
    patch=[[g[i][j] for j in range(cs,ce+1)] for i in range(rs,rs0)]
    ph,pw=len(patch),len(patch[0])
    # destination: find 0(==non-bg?) rectangle below
    # use the 0-colored region: rows with a cell equal to 0
    drows=[i for i in range(H) if 0 in g[i]]
    dr=min(drows); de=max(drows)+1
    dc=min(min(j for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==0 for i in drows)); 
    cc=max(max(j for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==0 for i in drows))
    p=np.array(patch); q=np.fliplr(p)
    for i in range(dr,de):
        for j in range(dc,cc):
            if cc-dc==pw and de-dr==ph: g[i][j]=int(q[i-dr][j-dc])
    return g
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
out=f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])
print(out==G['Demo pair 1 output'], out.tolist())
